findings.evidence:
`pkg/planner/core/task_base.go:255` changes `CopTask.physPlanPartInfo` to `*PhysPlanPartInfo`.
`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:1565` builds a `CopTask` in `buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader` without setting `physPlanPartInfo` (now `nil`).
`pkg/planner/core/task.go:537` assigns `PhysicalIndexLookUpReader.PlanPartInfo = t.physPlanPartInfo` (propagates `nil`).
When `StmtCtx.UseDynamicPartitionPrune()` is true and the index is global, executor build hits `pkg/executor/builder.go:4027` -> `getPartitionIDsAfterPruning(..., v.PlanPartInfo)`.
`pkg/executor/builder.go:5328` returns error on nil: "physPlanPartInfo in getPartitionIDsAfterPruning must not be nil".
findings.fix:
Ensure `CopTask.physPlanPartInfo` is non-nil for this admin path, e.g. set `cop.physPlanPartInfo = &PhysPlanPartInfo{}` (or fully populate it) in `PlanBuilder.buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader`, and audit other `CopTask{...}` constructors that can produce global-index plans.
Alternative: make `getPartitionIDsAfterPruning` treat nil as FullRange/all partitions instead of erroring.
findings.impact: With `tidb_partition_prune_mode=dynamic` (or any case where `StmtCtx.UseDynamicPartitionPrune()` is true), `ADMIN CHECK TABLE` / index-check paths that use `buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader` on partitioned tables with global indexes can fail at runtime with an internal error, blocking admin consistency checks and related maintenance operations.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on `upstream/master` (b75374faa619e24e380292fdbdf0f6fe5bf11943): `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go` still builds `CopTask` in `buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader` without setting `PhysPlanPartInfo`, while `pkg/executor/builder.go` still calls `getPartitionIDsAfterPruning(..., v.PlanPartInfo)` and `getPartitionIDsAfterPruning` still errors on nil.
findings.verify: Manual repro: set `tidb_partition_prune_mode='dynamic'`; create a partitioned table; create a global index; run `ADMIN CHECK TABLE t` (or the relevant admin check invoking index lookup). Expect it to succeed and not surface "physPlanPartInfo ... must not be nil".
findings.what: `CopTask.physPlanPartInfo` becoming a pointer introduces a nil-propagation bug in the admin index-lookup plan builder: `buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader` constructs a `CopTask` without `physPlanPartInfo`, leading to `PhysicalIndexLookUpReader.PlanPartInfo=nil`, which can error during executor build for global indexes under dynamic partition pruning.

subject: planner: add more test cases for Plan.Clone (#54588)
summary: Found a High-severity nil-propagation bug after converting partition-pruning info to pointers: the admin physical index-lookup builder can produce global-index plans with `PlanPartInfo=nil`, which errors under dynamic partition pruning; issue still present on `upstream/master`.
